sentences.en: There are very few shops and the cinema is awful.
sentences.zh: 这里的商店很少，电影院也很糟糕。

sentences.en: I never realized how awful living all alone could be.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过独自生活会如此糟糕。

sentences.en: The sound of an awful scream made him shudder.
sentences.zh: 一声可怕的尖叫让他打了个寒颤。

senses.zh: 令人不愉快的，可怕的，畏惧的，充满敬畏的，艰难的
